description.en-US: A selection of 111 letters of St. Jane Frances de Chantal, translated from the Plon edition by the Sisters of the Visitation, Harrow-on-the-Hill, with a preface by Cardinal Bourne and the judgment of St. Francis de Sales on her virtues. To St. Francis de Sales, the first Mothers of the Visitation, her children and the great of her day.
description.pt-BR: Seleção de 111 cartas de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal, traduzidas da edição Plon pelas Irmãs da Visitação de Harrow-on-the-Hill, com prefácio do cardeal Bourne e o juízo de são Francisco de Sales sobre as virtudes da Santa.

sources.edition: Selected Letters of Saint Jane Frances de Chantal, tr. the Sisters of the Visitation, Harrow, preface by Cardinal Bourne, R. & T. Washbourne, London, 1918 (imprimatur 1917). Project Gutenberg #50592 (Distributed Proofreaders).
sources.description: Gutenberg text with the Gutenberg header and licence removed; the translators’ footnotes are kept. "Vive [+] Jésus" keeps the cross of the original. Letters are numbered as in this selection, not as in Plon.
